summary: The official Đắk Lắk citizen portal exposes a public cadastral GeoJSON layer for Phường Buôn Ma Thuột. The layer returned 82,935 CRS84 features, and bounded parsing found one polygon containing the exact WUP point; runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial review.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Vietnamese discovery queries are recorded in the city record. Both led to the first-party Đắk Lắk viewer; the Vietnamese route exposed the local ward endpoint and 2024 parcel-sheet note.
requestOutcomes: Viewer GET, ward-list GET, ward-source GET, and GeoJSON GET succeeded. The GeoJSON was inspected for schema/CRS and safely bounded to source OBJECTID plus geometry for the exact-point test. The national land-inventory no-auth configuration endpoint returned 401; no login or credentials were used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [12.6770054028024, 108.041647928753] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and not shifted.
The public layer is a Phường Buôn Ma Thuột 2024 tờ/thửa layer; citywide completeness and 2025 boundary equivalence are unverified.
The exact-point hit is local geometry evidence, not proof of citywide or countrywide coverage.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal, or unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
safeFieldAllowlist: source layer and public service metadata
compositeKeyProvenance: Text=8(51) was observed as a display label and is not the canonical identity.
geometryQuality: verified public Polygon response; source layer contains 82,935 features
